rule_definition: close > prior 60 market-day maximum close AND volume > 1.5 * prior 20 market-day mean volume; windows exclude today
gross_labels: next market-day open to day t+20/t+60 close; missing endpoints/event transitions unknown; no future-result pool filter
limitations: official last/reference forward multiplier is a quote proxy, not shareholder total return
unverified events are not adjusted; crossing windows unknown
current type evidence is retrospective metadata, not historical announcement snapshot
